messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Number of CG
parts:
Hi,
There is no direct way. You need to convert methylKit objects (tiles and base-pair resolution) to GRanges and use countByOverlaps() function to count how many CpGs overlap with each tile. That value is calculated internally but not returned, and it will be problematic to return it, so you need to calculate it on your own using GenomicRanges functions if you need it.  

Best,
Altuna
